intro.title: The Entrance to the Cave
story: You stand before the mouth of a dark, damp cave. The air is cold and smells faintly of moss and old stone.
To your left, a wooden ladder leads up toward a illuminated ledge. Straight ahead, a dark passage disappears into total darkness.

ladder-arc.title: The Upper Ledge
story: You reach the top of the ladder and find a brightly lit room filled with ancient glowing runes.
Congratulations! You found the hidden treasure of the Gophers.

dark-passage.title: The Pitch Black Hallway
story: You take a few steps into the dark, but misstep and fall into a subterranean stream.
The current carries you away into the unknown depth...

options.text: Try swimming back to the entrance
